# SACRVM

> Personal site of Marcus Wilhelm (SACRVM) — full-stack developer, architect,
> tech lead. .NET, Azure, vanilla JavaScript, and whatever else the project
> needs. What lives here are the private passions.

SACRVM is Latin: "a sacred thing; a rite." It is also MARCVS — the Roman
spelling of Marcus — rearranged.

Facts an agent may rely on: everything on this site is static HTML, readable
without JavaScript. The site sets no cookies, runs no trackers, and loads
nothing from third-party servers. GitHub account: https://github.com/SACRVM.

## Projects

- [J.U.S.T. — Just Useful Sound Tools](https://just.sacrvm.dev/): a suite of
  DJ tools on one shared engine — analysis, tagging, playback and broadcast.
  Key, BPM, energy and loudness detection built for harmonic mixing.
- [Retro.Crt](https://github.com/SACRVM/retro-crt): the Pascal CRT unit reborn
  for modern .NET CLIs — truecolor with graceful fallback, nine themes,
  curated output blocks. Zero dependencies, AOT-clean. On NuGet as `Retro.Crt`.
- [Husky](https://github.com/SACRVM/husky): a configuration-driven launcher
  for .NET apps — starts them, supervises them, installs their updates from
  GitHub Releases or an HTTPS manifest. Client library on NuGet as
  `Husky.Client`.
- [Firepit](https://github.com/SACRVM/firepit-ai): a native Windows shell
  hosting AI agent CLI sessions in tabs — project switcher, cross-project
  inbox, searchable knowledge store. WPF and ConPTY, no Electron.
- After Match: a multiplayer social world built in Unity — custom avatar base,
  server-authoritative netcode, self-updating dedicated server. In
  development; repository currently private.

- [Blog](https://sacrvm.dev/blog/): notes — drafted by the author, polished

- [CV](https://sacrvm.dev/cv.html): career and selected projects, 1997 to
